name: Tech comfort
definition: Ease learning and using new apps and devices.
status: draft; weakest in test (0.75), needs varied angles

name: Price attention
definition: How closely the person watches costs and small fees.

name: Privacy stance
definition: Reluctance to hand personal data to companies.

name: Social ease
definition: Comfort dealing with people they do not know.

name: Time pressure
definition: How little spare time the person has.

name: Novelty seeking
definition: Readiness to try new things early.

name: Financial stress
definition: Felt strain on the household budget.
status: draft; a feeling, not a resource

name: Optimism
definition: How hopeful the person feels about their own future.

name: Safety concern
definition: How threatened the person feels in daily life.

name: Institutional trust
definition: How much the person believes institutions act honestly.

name: Liquidity
definition: Cash buffer, income level and steadiness.
status: draft: new, strongest missing driver per decision-science review

name: Habit and inertia
definition: Tendency to stay with existing choices.

name: Loss aversion
definition: How much losses weigh against gains.

name: Tenure (rent or own)
definition: Rents or owns the home. Read from demographics, not asked.

name: Life stage and household
definition: Age, children, caring duties. Read from demographics, not asked.
